description_for_human: Evaluate spreadsheet formulas via HTTP. Supports 400+ Excel-compatible functions.
description_for_model: Stateless spreadsheet calculation API. Send a 2D data grid and formulas (SUM, AVERAGE, COUNTIF, VLOOKUP, IF, etc.) to get computed results. Use POST /api/calc with JSON body. Use GET /api/calc to see full API schema with parameters, examples, and supported formula list. Best for: aggregations, conditional logic, lookups, and report generation on tabular data. Supports up to 50,000 rows. Use 'formulas' array param to evaluate multiple formulas in one request.
